catalog.summary: Fixes codes, titles, and other automatic metadata under the new rules. Your manual edits are kept.
catalog.title: Metadata and code cleanup

dangling-candidates.summary: Candidates left by deleted assets move to the file's new ID. Ones that don't match are withdrawn.
dangling-candidates.title: Stale review candidates

display-cloud.summary: Reads each cloud drive video, which adds cloud drive cache and traffic. Starts after you confirm.
display-cloud.title: Cloud drive video dimensions

display-local.summary: Rereads file headers of local and LAN videos to fix portrait and landscape detection.
display-local.title: Local video dimensions

follow-evidence.summary: Keeps the 3 most recent raw snapshots of each followed source and any snapshots items still reference. The rest are deleted and can't be restored.
follow-evidence.title: Old follow snapshots

garbled-people.summary: Removes people links left by early garbled scrapes, then fetches performers again.
garbled-people.title: Garbled people

javdb-entries.summary: Same-name performer pages that match the video credits as censored or uncensored no longer get a link. Subscriptions to them are turned off.
javdb-entries.title: JavDB links on people pages

resolution-tags.summary: A 4K tag on a metadata site means an official 4K release exists, not that this file is 4K. These tags are removed.
resolution-tags.title: 4K tags from sources

system-files.summary: Moves NAS system thumbnails, macOS ._ files, and similar extras out of the collection. The files aren't deleted.
system-files.title: System extras

setup.firstAccessDenied: Open Peach on the computer running Peach or on the same LAN to finish setup, or set PEACH_ACCESS_PASSWORD when starting the container.
